<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Definitions_StorageManagement" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ProductArrived" name="Ordered product arrived"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Order" name="Order to process"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check whether product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock_Split" name="In stock?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Withdraw" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reorder" name="Reorder product from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrived" name="Ordered product arrived">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_ProductArrived" messageRef="Msg_ProductArrived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delay_Split" name="Waited more than 10 days?"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DelayPenalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delay_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Register" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Available_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReady" name="Check whether order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Split" name="Order ready for shipment?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ship_Fork"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Pack" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ship_Join"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Ship" name="Ship order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNext" name="Select next product from order"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Order" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_InStock_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_Withdraw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_Withdraw" targetRef="Gateway_Available_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_Reorder" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrived" targetRef="Gateway_Delay_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Delay_Split" targetRef="Task_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Delay_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Delay_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_DelayPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_Delay_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Delay_Merge" targetRef="Task_Register"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_Register" targetRef="Gateway_Available_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Available_Merge" targetRef="Task_CheckReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_CheckReady" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Ship_Fork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectNext"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Ship_Fork" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Ship_Fork" targetRef="Task_Pack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_Ship_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_Pack" targetRef="Gateway_Ship_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Ship_Join" targetRef="Task_Ship"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_Ship" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_SelectNext" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_StorageManagement">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_StorageManagement" bpmnElement="Process_StorageManagement"/>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
